linkedin:
Your year-end count finds 940 units and the books say 1,000: usually the checked count goes in the accounts.

Then the real work starts: finding out why 60 units are missing.

Hypothetical example aside, the gap tends to come from three places:
• Goods sold but not booked out
• Deliveries received but not booked in
• Damage or loss nobody recorded

Is your stock count planned before the December close?
